entities.name: Query protein 741 aa
observations: Sequence analysis found 83.3% identity and 99.9% coverage to reviewed Parafrankia catalase-peroxidase A8LBC6; evidence strongly supports catalase-peroxidase function.
Sequence contains two Pfam peroxidase domains, PF00141 at residues 95–402 and 409–715.
Closely matching reviewed homologs are annotated as heme-b enzymes with catalase and broad-spectrum peroxidase activities; homologs are described as homodimers or homotetramers.
